Tiers: T0 phones (FXAA, plate lake), T1 desktop (MSAA 4, mirror lake LAKE_R12, half-size mirror target), T2. The user's words: "benerin pinggiran air di deket es itu kalo geser kamera kek low quality anti aliasing gitu, tapi dia aneh glitch gitu, make it smooth yaa" (the water edge near the ice looks like low-quality anti-aliasing when the camera moves, with a weird glitch; make it smooth) and today "priority benerin anti aliasing water yaa, ensure everything perfect". House rules: the user's words win; build nothing beyond the brief; look at your own images with the Read tool; report honestly.

HISTORY (read the LOGs; everything is mirrored under MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/)
  aa3/ (LOG.md, aa3.patch): AA3 = A tone-compressed resolve on the mirror lake (?aaresolve=0, also turns C off), B mirror redrawn every moving frame = the 20 Hz flash fix (?slabflash=0), C lake-edge TAA on the waterline band (?lktaa=0). Judged by 3 lenses (aa3/judge/*), one fix round (A-1 region-edge dashes fixed; far taps 3 px), rechecked: flash gone (also in the real rAF loop), no ghosting, texture, sky, switches, phones, Safari / Firefox all fine. OPEN after that round: per-box stepping at the near slab / rock waterlines; G7 cost +6.9..+10.4 % while moving (a separate AA5c perf track is working on it right now in lane aa5c :5195 - do not touch it); A-2 (TAA outliers at the governor's reduced render scales; the recheck says it REGRESSED after the fix round); A-3 (the compressed resolve's knee 0.5 darkens thin dark features beyond BASE and the 2x GT).
  aa5a/ (LOG.md, aa5a.patch vs aa3_judged): F1 glide = motion-adaptive history (0.85 at <= 0.15 px/frame -> 0.7 at >= 0.5 px/frame), AA3's clip and Catmull-Rom, no silhouette blur on band pixels while the TAA runs (band flagged by negative alpha), a still tail that ramps back exactly to AA3 at rest; switch ?lkglide=0 (== AA3). Its glide shaders are built from AA3's TAA_FRAG / EDGE_FRAG by exact text replacement that throws when an anchor is not found exactly once. Effect: the front-slab edge advances like the GT (crisper, without AA3's lumps); other boxes look like AA3; G4 against the blurred TAA-off frame counts the intended sharpening (90 px per Mpx-frame, balanced) but only 0.6 against the unblurred resolve.
  aa5b/ (LOG.md, aa5b.patch vs aa3_judged, Water.ts only): v3 far-floe guard = near a face's foot the walk reads the two bracketing rows of the half-size mirror target and gives a row lying farther than the front-most one the front-most row's colour (removes the floe's sunlit INSIDE that the oblique clip exposes under each foot - the cause of the pale block that popped in); switch ?ffblock=0 (== AA3). Pops vs GT: -41..-58 % px vs AA3, clusters removed 162 / added 22 (largest 33 px) on medium. The REST frame changes under the floes (10.6k px > 4 lv, moving toward the 2x GT).

LEAD DECISIONS (binding)

G3's rest clause is now 'identical to BASE except the intended edge smoothing and v3's under-floe reflection correction' - but every changed spot must look right at 1x (no new dark dashes, holes or bright columns).
  L4 G1's J rule: the lane's J32 / J48 reductions must be at least GT's minus 5 points; larger reductions are fine as long as G2 shows no lag, smear or trail.
  L5 G4 for F1 is measured against the unblurred resolve (?envedge=0) on band pixels: removing the band blur is intended sharpening. Required instead: no visible rim or outline at 1x and on a DPR-2 render, and no visible 'sharpness pumping' when the camera stops or starts (the tail ramps sigma 0.3 -> 0.6 over 24 still frames).

2. Merge AA5a into HeroEngine.ts and world/EnvEdge.ts with a 3-way merge per file: base = aa3_judged's file, ours = aa3_fixed1's file (it has the fix round's A-1 region checks and the 3-px far taps), theirs = the aa5a lane's file (git merge-file -p, then resolve by hand). AA5a builds its glide shaders from AA3's TAA_FRAG / EDGE_FRAG by exact text replacement: the fix round changed TAA_FRAG, so make sure every anchor is still found exactly once and that the glide variant carries the fix round's region checks too (glide on must still have A-1 fixed).
3. Prove the switches (ident.mjs-style: final image, all targets, all linked programs): ?lkglide=0 == aa3_fixed1 + v3; ?ffblock=0 == aa3_fixed1 + F1 (compare with a temporary clone built that way, or argue file by file and prove the two single-feature states by images on a medium capture); ?lkglide=0&ffblock=0 == aa3_fixed1; all five switches off == BASE; T0 and ?envlake=plate == BASE; tsc clean.
4. Prove the effects survived: F1's front-slab glide numbers and slices (as in aa5a's LOG) and v3's pop scan (as in aa5b's LOG) on medium, within noise of the originals.
5. Write aa6.patch vs BASE and aa6_vs_fixed1.patch; apply-test both on fresh clones (they must reproduce the lane exactly); mirror the patches and your LOG into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa6/integrator/. Leave the :5196 lab running on the final AA6 build for the pre-judges.

integ.conflicts:
aa5b.patch (Water.ts only) passed patch -p1 --dry-run cleanly and applied. The lane's Water.ts is now byte-identical to the aa5b lane's.

AA5a was merged with git merge-file -p per file (ours = aa3_fixed1, base = aa3_judged, theirs = aa5a lane). There were 4 textual conflicts. All were add/add (both sides added lines at the same spot), and each was resolved by keeping both sides, fix round first:
- HeroEngine.ts (2): the fix round's `tc` lktaaclip line next to AA5a's glide option block, and the fix round's clip/far spreads next to AA5a's `glide,` in enableTAA.
- EnvEdge.ts (2): EdgeTAAOptions clip?/far? next to glide?, and the TAA uniforms uPrevAAPlane/uPrevAAExc next to AA5a's uGlideW/uGlideC spread.

There was also 1 semantic conflict that git could not see. AA5a's third glide anchor was AA3's old clip line `h = clamp(h, max(mn, mu - 1.25 * sd), min(mx, mu + 1.25 * sd));\n  float w = uHistW;\n`. The fix round rewrote that line to `h = uClipG > 0.0 ? clamp(...uClipG...) : clamp(h, mn, mx);`, so glideReplace would have thrown at run time. I re-anchored it on the fix round's line and left the replacement text unchanged. At the product defaults (gamma 1.25, mode 0) the glide clip is exactly fixed1's clip.

The other 3 TAA anchors and the 4 EDGE_FRAG anchors were not touched by the fix round. The A-1 colour-tap check, the history-footprint check (taaInPrev) and the 3-px uFar taps sit outside the replaced text, so the glide program keeps them. I confirmed this in the linked rx-lake-edge-taa source with glide on: each fix-round line appears once, all glide replacements are present, and the old clip line is gone.

Result:
- EnvEdge.ts = fixed1 + AA5a's additions + the one re-anchored line.
- HeroEngine.ts = fixed1 + AA5a's additions.
- tsc (hero and project) is clean.

Its rest-frame change moves toward the 2x GT (4.4:1). The hold's crest train and ring reflections show no v3 artefact, and the hero and sky are unchanged. Two small v3 colour errors are clear at 4-8x and show only as small blocks or twinkles in motion at 1x: a dark band in the bright lake gap at the bottom-centre rock (R-1) and split dashes on the tiny far-left objects (R-2). Both are also in aa5b's original v3, and both point to the unbounded row replacement in LK_FFB_GLSL. A-3: knee 1.0 halves the over-darkening of thin dark features with no G1 loss. not_fixed.why: Needs the lead's decision, option (a). Cause confirmed on reverse: with band sigma 0.6 at every speed (?lkgsb=0.6) FS MC32 is -41 %; a fast weight of 0.5 gives -15 %; AA6 -22 %; GT -19 %. I built option (b), a per-pixel motion gate in EDGE_FRAG_GLIDE that recomputes the TAA's mv and applies smoothstep(0.5, 1.0) px/frame. FS improved only to fast -32 / reverse -30, still below the 40 % gate (fixed1 itself is -36). It also cost glide quality: medium REL 0.2017 -> 0.2063, ESF offset -0.11 -> -0.17, solid-side error 3.71 -> 4.20. The FS waterline speeds overlap between paths (slow p50 0.45 / p90 0.65 px/frame; fast and reverse p50 about 0.69), so any gate low enough to pass also takes the glide off the slow path. I removed the gate; the final EDGE_FRAG_GLIDE equals aa5a's. Final FS MC32: fast -22.9, reverse -21.9, diag -39.7 (integrator's -40.1), leave -40.8. Every other box and every total passes.

Forwarded to the v3 owner. Fixing it needs scale-aware row bracketing in v3's guard, which is a design investigation rather than a parameter fix.
Not a lane change. The lead's final-judge brief must name the G1 instrument. I measured G1 on aa5a's bloom-free NEW coverage masks throughout.
